_comment: #508. Same Edwardian/early-20th-century cottage stock, but a working-class version that has
been repainted by its owners rather than by a design review board - so this is the widest Base
in the belt (six draws) and the warmest. Cream and wheat next to a warm grey, a cool sage-grey
and a pinkish beige; the colours a street of small houses picks up one repaint at a time.
Accent1 carries that further than Noe: cream, a terra brown and a teal-grey, so door leaves and
window frames disagree with each other down the block. Accent2 stays a warm tan-to-brown
shadow line so the trim reads as trim.
Authored, not verified in an Editor.
